item.title: Senate measure to restore Mississippi voters’ right to ballot initiative advances
item.description: The Senate Elections Committee adopted a measure on Tuesday that would, at least partially, restore the system to allow Mississippians to bypass the Legislature and put issues to a statewide vote.
